There are three inequivalent Si sites. In the first Si site, Si is bonded to four O atoms to form SiO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two CaO₆ octahedra and corners with two NbO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 21-44°. There are a spread of Si-O bond distances ranging from 1.59-1.73 Å.
